description: Creating, assigning, overriding, unmanaging and deleting on Access Roles' dashboard page at 1366 px, as admin, on the probe's two users pageprobe-kid and pageprobe-teen (accessroles-admin-page-probe.mjs makes them and puts everything back): the Roles tab's New role from the Kid preset (its locks, Only…, the Dashboard row's sentence following "Block Dashboard data and server calls", "Administrators are not restricted."), named "Page probe Kid" with one library, previewed (nobody's access changes) and created; the Users tab's bulk Assign roles of it to both users, previewed per user (newly locked, libraries written) as Users/Bulk's own dry run; another administrator then changes pageprobe-kid through the API, so Assign is a 409 Changed naming them (a plain sentence, Assign disabled, nothing written) until "Reload and keep my changes" reads it again; then another administrator adds a Subtitles lock to the role (no token of the bulk's request covers the role, its preview's PreviewToken does), so Assign is a 409 Changed naming both users with nothing written, and after "Reload and keep my changes" the new preview (Subtitles newly locked) is saved; pageprobe-kid's panel: the Effective access with its sources, a Home override Unlock previewed and saved; Unmanage user with the choice asked first (no dry run until it is made), Keep's dry run held 4 s while Restore's answers at once, the late Keep answer dropped, Restore saved; then the Roles tab's Delete of the role, its last member pageprobe-teen leaving management with Restore, after another administrator changed the teen and changed it back: a 409 Changed naming the teen, the role kept, then Reload and keep my changes (Restore kept) and Delete. Every dialog is the kit's; the focus goes back where it was. Writes only the probe's role and the two users' assignments; the library sync writes their access, and Restore writes it back.

steps.name: sign in as admin
the web client is ready
steps.waitFor: !!window.ApiClient && !!ApiClient.getCurrentUserId()

steps.name: open Access Roles' page
the module mounted: the tabs, the status loaded, the loading note hidden
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); return !!p && p.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]').length === 8 && p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesStatus table').length === 5 && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesScriptNote').hidden === true; })()

steps.name: the check's helpers
the Roles tab
the Roles panel shown, New role enabled
steps.waitFor: __arPage.shown(document.querySelector('#AccessRolesPanelRoles')) && document.querySelector('#AccessRolesTabRoles').getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true' && document.querySelector('#AccessRolesNewRole').disabled === false

steps.name: New role
the presets
steps.waitFor: __arPage.title() === 'New role' && __arPage.top().querySelectorAll('[data-preset]').length === 4

steps.name: the Kid preset
the editor from the preset, the focus in it
steps.waitFor: __arPage.title() === 'New role: Kid' && __arPage.top().contains(document.activeElement)

steps.name: what the preset set
steps.eval: (() => { const t = __arPage.top(); return { locks: [...t.querySelectorAll('input[data-lock]')].filter(i => i.checked).map(i => i.getAttribute('data-lock')), mode: t.querySelector('select').value, hints: [...t.querySelectorAll('.jfar-page-check-hint')].map(h => h.textContent), dashboard: t.querySelector('.jfar-page-dashboard-text').textContent, admins: t.textContent.includes('Administrators are not restricted.'), libraries: [...t.querySelectorAll('.jfar-page-picker input[data-library-id]')].length }; })()

steps.name: Kid: eight locks, Only…, the Dashboard blocked, "hidden only" marked, a library to pick
steps.assert: JSON.stringify(__vars.preset.locks) === JSON.stringify(['Profile','DisplayAccount','Home','Controls','QuickConnect','EnhancedPanel','AdminSurfaces','UserDirectory']) && __vars.preset.mode === 'Only' && __vars.preset.hints.includes('hidden only') && __vars.preset.hints.includes('server-enforced') && /also blocks the admin data and server calls/.test(__vars.preset.dashboard) && __vars.preset.admins && __vars.preset.libraries > 0

steps.name: the Dashboard row: "Block Dashboard data and server calls" off and on again
steps.script: const t = __arPage.top(); const box = t.querySelector('input[data-lock="AdminSurfaces"]'); box.click(); const off = t.querySelector('.jfar-page-dashboard-text').textContent; box.click(); return { off, on: t.querySelector('.jfar-page-dashboard-text').textContent, checked: box.checked };

steps.name: the sentence follows the box
steps.assert: /doesn't block the admin data and server calls/.test(__vars.dashboardRow.off) && /also blocks the admin data and server calls/.test(__vars.dashboardRow.on) && __vars.dashboardRow.checked === true

steps.name: Only… with nothing picked: Create
refused in the page (pick a library), no preview
steps.waitFor: __arPage.top().querySelector('.jfar-page-error').textContent === 'Pick at least one library.' && __arPage.panels().length === 1 && __arPage.title() === 'New role: Kid'

steps.name: the name
one library: the first enabled one that isn't the Collections library
steps.script: const t = __arPage.top(); const label = [...t.querySelectorAll('.jfar-page-picker label')].find(l => !/disabled|collection/.test(l.textContent)); const box = label.querySelector('input'); box.click(); return { id: box.getAttribute('data-library-id'), name: label.querySelector('.jfar-page-check-text span').textContent, checked: box.checked };

steps.name: Create: the preview first
the preview: nobody's access changes, Create enabled
steps.waitFor: __arPage.title() === "Create role Page probe Kid" && !!__arPage.top().querySelector('.jfar-page-preview-summary') && __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Create').disabled === false

steps.name: what it says
create
both dialogs closed, the role listed with its libraries and Dashboard row, a toast
steps.waitFor: __arPage.panels().length === 0 && !!__arPage.role("Page probe Kid") && __arPage.toasts().includes("Role Page probe Kid saved.")

steps.name: the role's lines
no member yet, its locks, Only: the library, the Dashboard blocked, other users hidden
steps.assert: __vars.roleLines[0] === 'No one has this role yet' && /^Settings locked: Profile/.test(__vars.roleLines[1]) && __vars.roleLines[2] === 'Libraries: Only: ' + __vars.library.name && /^Dashboard: /.test(__vars.roleLines[3]) && __vars.roleLines[4] === 'Other users: hidden'

steps.name: the Users tab
the probe's users listed
steps.waitFor: __arPage.shown(document.querySelector('#AccessRolesPanelUsers')) && !!__arPage.user("pageprobe-kid") && !!__arPage.user("pageprobe-teen")

steps.name: tick both
two selected, Assign roles enabled
Assign roles…
the roles to give
steps.waitFor: __arPage.title() === 'Assign roles for 2 users'

steps.name: tick the probe's role, Continue
the preview of both users' whole assignments
steps.waitFor: __arPage.title() === 'Assign roles' && !!__arPage.top().querySelector('.jfar-page-preview-summary') && __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Assign').disabled === false

steps.name: what it says, per user
steps.eval: (() => { const t = __arPage.top(); return { summary: t.querySelector('.jfar-page-preview-summary').textContent, users: [...t.querySelectorAll('.jfar-page-preview-user')].map(u => ({ name: u.querySelector('.jfar-page-preview-name').textContent, lines: [...u.querySelectorAll('.jfar-page-preview-line')].map(l => l.textContent) })) }; })()

steps.name: two users, each newly locked and their library access written
steps.assert: __vars.bulkPreview.summary === 'This changes the access of 2 users:' && __vars.bulkPreview.users.length === 2 && __vars.bulkPreview.users.every(u => u.lines.some(l => /^Newly locked: Profile/.test(l)) && u.lines.includes('The library sync will write their library access.'))

steps.name: another administrator changes pageprobe-kid after the preview (a Playback lock of their own, through the API)
steps.script: const kid = await __arPage.row('pageprobe-kid'); await __arPage.api('PUT', 'AccessRoles/Admin/Users/' + kid.UserId, { UserId: kid.UserId, RoleIds: [], LockOverrides: { Playback: 'Lock' }, Libraries: { Mode: 'Inherit', Add: [], Remove: [] }, State: 'Managed', IfUpdatedAt: kid.UpdatedUtc || null }); const now = await __arPage.row('pageprobe-kid'); return { state: now.State, roles: now.RoleIds.length };

steps.name: the kid is managed now, with no role
Assign: the preview's request, out of date now
409 Changed: the plain sentence naming pageprobe-kid with Reload and keep my changes, Assign disabled, the old preview gone
steps.waitFor: __arPage.title() === 'Assign roles' && __arPage.stale() === 'This changed after you opened it (pageprobe-kid), in another tab or by another administrator, so nothing was saved. Reload to read it again with your changes put back over it, and check the new preview before you save.' && !!__arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Reload and keep my changes') && __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Assign').disabled === true && !__arPage.top().querySelector('.jfar-page-preview-summary')

steps.name: nothing was written: neither user has the role, the teen still unmanaged
steps.eval: (async () => { const rows = await __arPage.rows(); return ['pageprobe-kid', 'pageprobe-teen'].map(n => { const r = rows.find(x => x.Name === n); return { name: n, roles: r.RoleIds.length, state: r.State }; }); })()

steps.name: no role given to anyone
Reload and keep my changes
steps.script: __arPage.press(__arPage.top(), 'Reload and keep my changes'); return true;

steps.name: the new preview: both users again, Assign enabled, the sentence gone
steps.waitFor: __arPage.title() === 'Assign roles' && __arPage.stale() === null && !!__arPage.top().querySelector('.jfar-page-preview-summary') && __arPage.top().querySelector('.jfar-page-preview-summary').textContent === 'This changes the access of 2 users:' && __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Assign').disabled === false

steps.name: another administrator adds a Subtitles lock to Page probe Kid after this preview (through the API; the bulk's IfUpdatedAt doesn't cover the role, its preview's PreviewToken does)
steps.script: const roles = () => ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('AccessRoles/Admin/Roles')); const r = (await roles()).find(x => x.Name === "Page probe Kid"); await __arPage.api('PUT', 'AccessRoles/Admin/Roles/' + r.Id, { Name: r.Name, Description: r.Description, Locks: r.Locks.concat(['Subtitles']), Libraries: { Mode: r.Libraries.Mode, Refs: r.Libraries.Refs.map(x => ({ Id: x.Id })) }, IfUpdatedAt: r.UpdatedUtc, IfMembers: r.MembersToken }); const now = (await roles()).find(x => x.Name === "Page probe Kid"); return { locks: now.Locks };

steps.name: the role locks Subtitles now
Assign: the preview's effect, out of date now
409 Changed (ifPreview): the plain sentence naming both users with Reload and keep my changes, Assign disabled, the old preview gone
steps.waitFor: __arPage.title() === 'Assign roles' && /^This changed after you opened it \((pageprobe-kid, pageprobe-teen|pageprobe-teen, pageprobe-kid)\), in another tab or by another administrator, so nothing was saved\. /.test(__arPage.stale() || '') && !!__arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Reload and keep my changes') && __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Assign').disabled === true && !__arPage.top().querySelector('.jfar-page-preview-summary')

steps.name: nothing was written: neither user has the role
steps.eval: (async () => { const rows = await __arPage.rows(); return ['pageprobe-kid', 'pageprobe-teen'].map(n => { const r = rows.find(x => x.Name === n); return { name: n, roles: r.RoleIds.length, state: r.State }; }); })()

steps.name: no role given to anyone, the teen still unmanaged
Reload and keep my changes (the role as it is now)
steps.script: __arPage.press(__arPage.top(), 'Reload and keep my changes'); return true;

steps.name: the new preview: both users, Subtitles newly locked for each, Assign enabled
steps.waitFor: __arPage.title() === 'Assign roles' && __arPage.stale() === null && !!__arPage.top().querySelector('.jfar-page-preview-summary') && __arPage.top().querySelector('.jfar-page-preview-summary').textContent === 'This changes the access of 2 users:' && [...__arPage.top().querySelectorAll('.jfar-page-preview-user')].every(u => [...u.querySelectorAll('.jfar-page-preview-line')].some(l => /^Newly locked: .*Subtitles/.test(l.textContent))) && __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Assign').disabled === false

steps.name: assign
both have the role, the selection cleared
steps.waitFor: __arPage.panels().length === 0 && ["pageprobe-kid", "pageprobe-teen"].every(n => { const r = __arPage.user(n); return !!r && r.querySelector('.jfar-page-user-line').textContent === "Roles: Page probe Kid · Managed"; }) && document.querySelector('#AccessRolesPanelUsers .jfar-page-count').textContent === 'No user selected'

steps.name: open pageprobe-kid's panel (the focus on the name first)
steps.script: const b = __arPage.user("pageprobe-kid").querySelector('.jfar-page-user-name'); b.focus(); b.click(); return true;

steps.name: the panel with the effective access
steps.waitFor: __arPage.title() === "pageprobe-kid" && !!__arPage.top().querySelector('#AccessRolesEffective')

steps.name: what the panel shows
steps.eval: (() => { const t = __arPage.top(); return { roles: [...t.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesUserRoles label')].filter(l => l.querySelector('input').checked).map(l => l.textContent), overrides: [...t.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesUserOverrides .jfar-page-check-hint')].map(h => h.textContent), mode: t.querySelector('#AccessRolesUserMode').value, effective: [...t.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesEffective li')].map(l => l.textContent), summary: t.querySelector('.jfar-page-effective-summary').textContent }; })()

steps.name: the role ticked, the locks by the role, the library granted by it, the others not granted
steps.assert: __vars.panel.roles.length === 1 && __vars.panel.roles[0] === "Page probe Kid" && __vars.panel.overrides.includes("Now: Locked by role Page probe Kid") && __vars.panel.mode === 'Inherit' && __vars.panel.effective.includes(__vars.library.name + ': granted by role ' + "Page probe Kid") && __vars.panel.effective.filter(l => /: not granted by any role$/.test(l)).length > 0 && __vars.panel.summary === 'They see 1 library.'

steps.name: Home: Unlock for this user, Save
steps.script: const t = __arPage.top(); const s = t.querySelector('select[data-lock="Home"]'); s.value = 'Unlock'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); t.querySelector('#AccessRolesUserSave').click(); return true;

steps.name: the preview: Home unlocked for them
steps.waitFor: __arPage.title() === "Save pageprobe-kid" && __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Save') && __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Save').disabled === false && [...__arPage.top().querySelectorAll('.jfar-page-preview-line')].some(l => l.textContent === 'Unlocked: Home screen')

steps.name: save
the panel again, with the override's source
steps.waitFor: __arPage.panels().length === 1 && __arPage.title() === "pageprobe-kid" && [...__arPage.top().querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesUserOverrides .jfar-page-check-hint')].some(h => h.textContent === 'Now: Unlocked for this user') && __arPage.toasts().includes("Saved pageprobe-kid.")

steps.name: Unmanage user…
the choice is asked first: no dry run until it is made (a hint instead of a preview), Unmanage disabled
steps.waitFor: __arPage.title() === "Unmanage pageprobe-kid" && __arPage.shown(__arPage.top().querySelector('.jfar-page-preview-choice')) && !__arPage.top().querySelector('.jfar-page-preview-summary') && __arPage.top().textContent.includes('Choose what their library access becomes; the preview follows.') && __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Unmanage').disabled === true

steps.name: hold Unmanage's dry runs 4 s (a slow answer)
Keep current access (its dry run held)
stop holding
Restore original access (its dry run answered at once)
the preview again: their original access restored, Unmanage enabled (before the held Keep answer)
steps.waitFor: __arPage.previewLines().some(l => /is no longer managed for libraries\. Their original access is restored: /.test(l)) && __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Unmanage').disabled === false

steps.name: after the held Keep answer arrived
steps.eval: ({ checked: __arPage.top().querySelector('input[type=radio]:checked').value, restored: __arPage.previewLines().some(l => /Their original access is restored: /.test(l)), frozen: __arPage.previewLines().some(l => /frozen/.test(l)), save: __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Unmanage').disabled === false })

steps.name: the late answer was dropped: Restore chosen, its preview shown, Unmanage enabled
unmanage
the panel again, with no assignment (no Unmanage user)
steps.waitFor: __arPage.panels().length === 1 && __arPage.title() === "pageprobe-kid" && !__arPage.top().querySelector('#AccessRolesUnmanage') && __arPage.toasts().includes("Unmanaged pageprobe-kid.")

steps.name: close the panel
closed, the focus on the user's name
steps.waitFor: __arPage.panels().length === 0 && document.activeElement === __arPage.user("pageprobe-kid").querySelector('.jfar-page-user-name')

steps.name: the Roles tab again
the role has one member now
steps.waitFor: __arPage.shown(document.querySelector('#AccessRolesPanelRoles')) && __arPage.role("Page probe Kid").querySelector('.jfar-page-role-line').textContent === "Members: pageprobe-teen"

steps.name: Delete
its member named
steps.waitFor: __arPage.title() === "Delete role Page probe Kid" && __arPage.top().textContent.includes("Its 1 member loses it: pageprobe-teen.")

steps.name: Continue
the preview: the member leaves library management, the choice required
steps.waitFor: __arPage.panels().length === 2 && __arPage.title() === "Delete role Page probe Kid" && !!__arPage.top().querySelector('.jfar-page-preview-summary') && __arPage.shown(__arPage.top().querySelector('.jfar-page-preview-choice')) && __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Delete').disabled === true && __arPage.top().textContent.includes("pageprobe-teen is no longer managed for libraries.")

steps.name: Restore original access
Delete enabled
steps.waitFor: __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Delete').disabled === false && [...__arPage.top().querySelectorAll('.jfar-page-preview-line')].some(l => /Their original access is restored: /.test(l.textContent))

steps.name: another administrator changes pageprobe-teen and changes it back (the role's members token moves, the assignment is as it was)
steps.script: const put = async (overrides) => { const t = await __arPage.row('pageprobe-teen'); return __arPage.api('PUT', 'AccessRoles/Admin/Users/' + t.UserId, { UserId: t.UserId, RoleIds: t.RoleIds, LockOverrides: overrides, Libraries: { Mode: 'Inherit', Add: [], Remove: [] }, State: 'Managed', IfUpdatedAt: t.UpdatedUtc }); }; await put({ Subtitles: 'Lock' }); await put({}); const t = await __arPage.row('pageprobe-teen'); return { roles: t.RoleIds.length, state: t.State };

steps.name: the teen still has the role
Delete: the preview's request, out of date now
409 Changed: the sentence naming pageprobe-teen with Reload and keep my changes, Delete disabled
steps.waitFor: __arPage.panels().length === 2 && __arPage.title() === "Delete role Page probe Kid" && __arPage.stale() === 'This changed after you opened it (pageprobe-teen), in another tab or by another administrator, so nothing was saved. Reload to read it again with your changes put back over it, and check the new preview before you save.' && __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Delete').disabled === true

steps.name: nothing was deleted: the role is there, the teen has it
the role and its member as they were
Reload and keep my changes
steps.script: __arPage.press(__arPage.top(), 'Reload and keep my changes'); return true;

steps.name: the new preview: Restore kept, Delete enabled
steps.waitFor: __arPage.stale() === null && __arPage.top().querySelector('input[type=radio]:checked') && __arPage.top().querySelector('input[type=radio]:checked').value === 'Restore' && __arPage.previewLines().some(l => /Their original access is restored: /.test(l)) && __arPage.button(__arPage.top(), 'Delete').disabled === false

steps.name: delete
the role gone, the dialogs closed
steps.waitFor: __arPage.panels().length === 0 && !__arPage.role("Page probe Kid") && __arPage.toasts().includes("Role Page probe Kid deleted.")

steps.name: every value is text: no element the page made from a value (no img, b, i, script under the page or a dialog)
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
